paper_provenance_audit.paper_citation: Xue Han et al., arXiv:2503.04150v3 (Table 1 tested Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen2.5-7B, LLaMA2-7B, LLaMA2-13B)
paper_provenance_audit.verdict: The four 0.5B scores are purely partner-experimental results from commit 72f4a50, NOT published numbers in the original TickTack paper.

evaluation_protocol.partner: Academic Choice Logit Scoring (arg_max over candidate token logits: [' A', 'A', ' B', 'B', ' C', 'C', ' D', 'D'] or [' Yes', 'Yes', ' No', 'No'])
evaluation_protocol.learning_track: P12_TASK_AWARE_CHATML with RAW_GREEDY_V1 (free autoregressive vocabulary generation over 151,936 tokens followed by strict regex parsing)

adapter_architecture.learning_track: Dual-Cycle MaT-LoRA on 72 MLP modules (gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj, rank=8, alpha=16.0, K=2)

temporal_injection.partner: Broadcasting: inputs_embeds = embed_tokens(input_ids) + te across ALL sequence tokens
temporal_injection.learning_track: GatedResidualProjection(40 -> 896) at token index 14 with alpha_0 = 0.0

training_schedule.partner: Joint Post-training (all 2,461 items in 1 offline pool, 2 epochs)
training_schedule.learning_track: Stagewise Continual Training (1947 -> 1984 -> 2022) to measure BWT and catastrophic forgetting
